purpose: Teach: 女児/インサイダー/安保理/郵政省/運輸省/建設省/日本共産党/中共

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、女児誘拐事件を、警察、厳しく捜査されますね
lines.en: So the police are conducting a thorough investigation into this child abduction case, correct?
lines.style: Measured, slightly formal tone. Speaking as if confirming details for understanding. Quiet curiosity — not challenging, genuinely asking to clarify. Steady pace, even breath.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、インサイダー取引の摘発もされますね
lines.en: The police also handle insider trading investigations as part of that scope.
lines.style: Professional, matter-of-fact delivery. No inflection at the edges — stating fact as routine. Clipped precision. The voice of someone used to listing responsibilities.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、安保理決議関連の警備を、警察、担当されますね
lines.en: And the police manage security related to UN Security Council resolutions as well, is that right?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly deferential tone. A genuine question wrapped in politeness. Pauses slightly before the question marker, as if gathering the next thought. Quiet and careful.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、旧郵政省関連の文書窃盗にも対応します
lines.en: The police also respond to document theft cases connected to the former Postal Ministry.
lines.style: Steady, administrative voice. Speaking with the authority of someone listing actual duties. No tone variation — efficient, clear. The words land with quiet competence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、旧運輸省OBの不正を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police would also handle corruption cases involving former Ministry of Transport officials, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Reflective, gently probing tone. Respectful distance. Not accusatory — more like piecing together how the system works. Even breath, careful word choice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、旧建設省OBの汚職事案も担当します
lines.en: The police also monitor corruption cases involving former Ministry of Construction officials.
lines.style: Neutral, cataloguing tone. Businesslike delivery, as if reading from a list. No judgment, no emphasis — just stating scope. Clear and direct.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、日本共産党関連の集会警備も、警察、されますね
lines.en: The police also provide security for rallies connected to the Japan Communist Party, correct?
lines.style: Careful, slightly cautious tone. Building on the pattern of previous questions. Measured pace, respectful distance. Seeking confirmation without presumption.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、中共系団体の動向も注視します
lines.en: The police also monitor the activities of China-affiliated organizations.
lines.style: Composed, precise delivery. Official register — the voice of institutional awareness. Slight emphasis on 'monitor' but otherwise matter-of-fact. Cool, professional distance.
